notes: This contract pins Umbra's opt-in, non-installable IEEE 1516.1-2025 Query Attribute Ownership development slice to the exact C++ query and ownership-report callback declarations exported by the Requirements Lab. It verifies only official signatures, declared exception sets, adapter symbols, and real Catch2 selectors. The current runtime reports a joined federate owner through Inform Attribute Ownership, attributes available for acquisition through Attribute Is Not Owned, and discovered RTI-owned joined-federate MOM attributes through Attribute Is Owned By RTI; it validates the requester's currently known class, groups attributes by result, and nullifies a queued report after Remove Object Instance begins. The RTI-owned callback is limited to the explicit MOM ledger and does not invent a sentinel federate handle. Ownership acquisition/divestiture, RTI-owned mutation/resign disposition, timestamped/retraction behavior, DDM, FOM sharing-policy enforcement, save/restore, remote transport, packaging, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice.
